raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "Both public routes now use `phoneSchema`, which strips spaces, dashes, dots, parentheses and Unicode dashes before applying the original 10–15 digit regex. It then normalizes to `+digits`, so `+7 (701) 555-12-34` and `+77015551234` are stored identically and match the existing unique (business, phone) client lookup. Inputs like `call me` and `+7 701` are still rejected. The wizard has no client-side phone validation that would block these inputs."}
